49ers vs Rams Betting History

The San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Rams have met 123 times since the 1966 season. The 49ers lead the series 66-55-2. Against the closing spread the 49ers are 67-52-3 (Rams 52-67-3), and the over is 48-48 in meetings with a closing total. Last meeting: Sep 10, 2026, 49ers 27-7.
